title: Project Fetch: Phase two
summary_en: Frontier Red Team research exploring Phase two of Project Fetch, investigating advanced AI capabilities and security implications.
summary_zh: Frontier Red Team 发布 Project Fetch 第二阶段研究，深入探索前沿 AI 能力的安全边界与对抗场景，评估高级模型在自主规划、工具使用方面的潜在风险。

title: Agentic coding and persistent returns to expertise
summary_en: Economic Research study analyzing ~400,000 Claude Code sessions from ~235,000 people, providing evidence on how coding agents deliver persistent returns to expertise.
summary_zh: 基于约 40 万次 Claude Code 对话分析，研究发现编程Agent能持续提升开发者专业能力，经验丰富的开发者可获得更显著的效率增益。

title: Paving the way for agents in biology
summary_en: Science research exploring how AI agents can accelerate and transform biological research workflows and experimental design.
summary_zh: 探索 AI Agent 如何加速生物学研究：从实验设计到数据分析，Agent 可自主完成生物实验全流程，为科研范式变革铺路。

title: Measuring LLMs' impact on N-day exploits
summary_en: Frontier Red Team study quantifying how large language models affect the speed and effectiveness of N-day vulnerability exploitation in cybersecurity.
summary_zh: 量化大语言模型对 N-day 漏洞利用效率的影响：研究揭示 LLM 可显著缩短漏洞从发现到利用的时间窗口，对网络安全防御提出新挑战。

title: Making Claude a chemist
summary_en: Science research demonstrating Claude's capabilities in chemistry tasks including molecular reasoning, reaction prediction, and experimental design.
summary_zh: 展示 Claude 在化学任务中的能力，包括分子推理、反应预测和实验方案设计，验证 AI 作为化学研究助手的可行性。

title: Mapping AI-enabled cyber threats: Insights from the LLM ATT&CK Navigator
summary_en: Frontier Red Team research mapping AI-enabled cyber threats using the LLM ATT&CK Navigator framework for systematic threat analysis and mitigation.
summary_zh: 基于 LLM ATT&CK Navigator 框架，系统映射 AI 驱动的网络威胁全景，为防御方提供威胁建模和缓解策略的结构化视角。

title: A near-autonomous AI chemist improves a challenging reaction in medicinal chemistry
summary_en: OpenAI and Molecule.one show how a near-autonomous AI chemist using GPT-5.4 improved a key drug-making reaction, advancing medicinal chemistry research.
summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Molecule.one 合作，利用 GPT-5.4 搭建近自主 AI 化学家系统，成功优化关键药物合成反应，推动药物研发流程革新。

title: Introducing LifeSciBench
summary_en: An expert-authored, expert-reviewed benchmark for evaluating how AI systems handle real-world life science research tasks and decisions.
summary_zh: 发布 LifeSciBench，由领域专家编写和审校的生命科学基准测试，用于评估 AI 系统处理真实科研任务的能力，填补该领域评测空白。

title: Dreaming: Better memory for a more helpful ChatGPT
summary_en: ChatGPT introduces a new memory system called Dreaming to better remember user preferences, keeping context fresh and relevant across conversations.
summary_zh: ChatGPT 推出 Dreaming 新记忆系统，通过后台整理对话历史与偏好，实现跨会话记忆保鲜，让助手更懂用户、回复更贴合上下文。

title: Introducing new capabilities to GPT-Rosalind
summary_en: GPT-Rosalind advances life sciences research with enhanced biological reasoning, medicinal chemistry expertise, genomics analysis, and experimental workflow capabilities.
summary_zh: GPT-Rosalind 迎来重大升级：增强生物推理、药物化学、基因组学分析及实验工作流能力，打造面向生命科学的专业 AI 平台。

title: Strengthening societal resilience with Rosalind Biodefense
summary_en: OpenAI launches Rosalind Biodefense, expanding trusted access to GPT-Rosalind for vetted developers and U.S. government partners advancing biodefense and public health.
summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Rosalind Biodefense 计划，向受信开发者和美国政府机构开放 GPT-Rosalind，用于生物防御、公共卫生和大流行防范。

title: An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry
summary_en: An OpenAI model solved the 80-year-old unit distance problem, disproving a major conjecture in discrete geometry — a milestone in AI-driven mathematics.
summary_zh: OpenAI 模型攻克 80 年未解的「单位距离问题」，推翻离散几何核心猜想，标志着 AI 驱动的数学研究取得里程碑式突破。

title: New research shows how AMIE, our medical AI, could help manage health conditions.
summary_en: Research in “Nature” shows our conversational AI system matches primary care physicians in complex disease management.
summary_zh: 发表在 Nature 的研究显示，DeepMind 医疗对话系统 AMIE 在复杂疾病管理任务中匹配初级保健医生水平，验证了对话式 AI 在临床场景的潜力。
author: Mike Schaekermann

title: We’re strengthening our presence in Alabama through new investments and community support.
summary_en: Google has announced a $1.5 billion investment for 2026 and 2027 to expand its data center campus in Jackson County, Alabama. Operating since 2019 on a repurposed former…
summary_zh: Google 宣布 2026-2027 年投资 15 亿美元扩建阿拉巴马数据中心园区，强化 AI 基础设施布局，支持日益增长的云计算和 AI 工作负载需求。

title: Our new community investments in Virginia support local jobs and expand energy affordability.
summary_en: We’re helping build the state’s next-generation workforce and investing in energy programs.
summary_zh: Google 在弗吉尼亚州启动新一轮社区投资，聚焦下一代劳动力培养和能源可负担性项目，与 AI 基础设施建设同步推进。

title: The latest AI news we announced in May 2026
summary_en: May AI recap
summary_zh: Google AI 五月月度回顾：汇总 Gemini 更新、搜索 AI 增强、新工具和研究成果，全面展现 Google 在 AI 领域的多线并进态势。
author: Blog Team

title: 5 ways Google Search can level up your thrift and vintage shopping
summary_en: A colorful, grain-textured collage of various items scattered across a light blue background. The items include a green bucket hat, a wooden clothes hanger, a blue-and-red striped collar, blue sunglasses, denim shorts, a yellow price tag, a red high-heele
summary_zh: Google Search 推出 5 项 AI 增强功能帮助用户淘二手好物：智能识别品牌、比价、风格推荐，让复古和二手购物更高效精准。
author: Megan Stoner

title: How we used Gemini to build Google I/O 2026
summary_en: A collage of I/O-related images, including the Antigravity Coffee Co. pop-up, a colorful jellyfish and a still from the Timmy TPU video. The word AI repeats three times on the left of the image, and there are colorful icons, including a sparkle, as well.
summary_zh: 揭秘如何用 Gemini 构建 Google I/O 2026：从内容策划到互动体验，AI 深度参与大会全流程设计与执行，展现 GenAI 在大型活动中的应用潜力。
author: Marvin Chow

title: Introducing Muse Spark: Scaling Towards Personal Superintelligence
summary_en: Muse Spark is the first LLM from Meta Superintelligence Labs — small and fast by design, capable of reasoning through complex questions in science, math and health.
summary_zh: Meta 超级智能实验室发布首款 LLM Muse Spark：小而快的设计，能在科学、数学和健康问题上进行深度推理，定位于个人超级智能的中间步骤。

title: Scaling How We Build and Test Our Most Advanced AI
summary_en: Research on Meta's advanced AI scaling framework covering comprehensive safety standards, rigorous testing, and deployment safeguards for frontier models.
summary_zh: Meta 发布前沿 AI 扩展框架：涵盖安全标准、严格测试和部署保障，建立从研发到上线全链路的高级模型治理体系。

title: How Alta Daily Uses Meta's Segment Anything to Reimagine the Digital Closet
summary_en: Alta Daily leverages Meta's Segment Anything model to create a revolutionary fashion app that reimagines the digital closet experience.
summary_zh: 时尚 App Alta Daily 利用 Meta SAM 模型重构数字衣橱体验，实现衣物精准识别与虚拟试穿，展示视觉 AI 在消费领域的创新应用。

title: SAM 3.1: Faster and More Accessible Real-Time Video Detection and Tracking
summary_en: SAM 3.1 introduces multiplexing and global reasoning for faster, more accessible real-time video detection and tracking capabilities.
summary_zh: SAM 3.1 发布：引入多路复用和全局推理机制，实时视频目标检测与追踪速度更快、精度更高，开源模型让更多开发者触手可及。

title: Four MTIA Chips in Two Years: Scaling AI Experiences for Billions
summary_en: Meta's custom MTIA chip program delivers four generations in two years, scaling AI infrastructure to support billions of users worldwide.
summary_zh: Meta 定制 MTIA 芯片两年内迭代四代，AI 推理加速能力大幅提升，支撑数十亿用户的 AI 体验，展示自研芯片在规模化部署中的价值。

title: Introducing TRIBE v2: A Predictive Foundation Model for Human Brain Processing
summary_en: TRIBE v2 is a predictive foundation model trained to understand how the human brain processes complex stimuli, advancing neuroscience AI research.
summary_zh: TRIBE v2 是预测人脑处理复杂刺激的基础模型，通过理解神经信号活动模式，推进 AI 对脑科学研究的辅助能力。

title: Calibration Without Comprehension: Diagnosing the Limits of Fine-Tuning LLMs for Vulnerability Detection in Systems Software
summary_en: Whether LLMs scoring well on vulnerability benchmarks genuinely reason about security or merely pattern-match on contaminated data remains unresolved. We present CWE-Trace, a framework for LLM vulnerability detection built from 834 manually curated Linux kernel samples spanning 74 CWEs. The framework enforces a strict temporal split (pre-2025 historical set / post-cutoff leakage-free set), preserv
summary_zh: 深度求索团队提出 CWE-Trace 框架，基于 834 个 Linux 内核样本测试 LLM 漏洞检测能力，发现模型在校准与真实理解之间存在显著差距。

title: Contagion Networks: Evaluator Bias Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
summary_en: When large language models serve as evaluators in multi-agent systems, their systematic evaluation biases propagate through the agent network. We introduce Contagion Networks, a formal framework for measuring how evaluator biases spread across interacting LLM agents. In a controlled 3-agent experiment using DeepSeek-chat with three distinct evaluator bias profiles (structured, balanced, evidence-b
summary_zh: 提出 Contagion Networks 形式框架，量化多智能体 LLM 系统中评估者偏差的传播路径，通过受控实验验证偏差在网络化智能体间的级联放大效应。

title: Process-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Theorem Proving via Lean
summary_en: While reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically has relied on a single binary verification signal, symbolic proof assistants in formal reasoning offer rich, fine-grained structured feedback. This gap between structured processes and unstructured rewards highlights the importance of feedback that is both dense and sound. In this work, we demonstrate that the Lean proof assista
summary_zh: 利用 Lean 证明助手的结构化反馈，提出过程验证的强化学习方法用于定理证明，展示细粒度、可靠的过程奖励对形式化数学推理的增益效果。

title: Repository-Level Solidity Code Generation with Large Language Models: From Prompting to Fine-Tuning
summary_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in general-purpose code generation, but their effectiveness in specialized software domains remains underexplored. Solidity smart contracts represent a high-stakes domain where generated code must satisfy strict language-level, security, and software-engineering constraints. Existing benchmarks and metrics remain insufficient for reposito
summary_zh: 研究 LLM 在 Solidity 智能合约代码生成中的效果，从 Prompt 工程到微调进行系统对比，揭示专用领域代码生成中安全性和工程约束的双重挑战。

title: SAC: Disaggregated KV Cache System for Sparse Attention LLMs with CXL
summary_en: The scaling of LLMs toward long-context inference has shifted the primary serving system bottleneck from computation to memory capacity. Traditional solutions for dense attention models rely on RDMA-based disaggregated memory pools, which perform coarse-grained fetching of the entire prefix KV cache from remote storage to local memory before decoding. However, this approach is fundamentally ineffi
summary_zh: 提出 SAC 系统：针对稀疏注意力 LLM 的 KV 缓存分离架构，利用 CXL 内存池实现细粒度缓存管理，解决长上下文推理中的内存瓶颈问题。

title: Uncertainty Decomposition for Clarification Seeking in LLM Agents
summary_en: Recent position papers argue that the classical aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty framework is insufficient for interactive large language model (LLM) agents and call for underspecification-aware, decomposed, and communicable uncertainty representations that can unlock new agent capabilities such as proactive clarification seeking and shared mental-model building. Practical deployment constraints --
summary_zh: 提出面向 LLM Agent 的不确定性分解方法，实现清晰可沟通的不确定性表征，解锁 Agent 主动澄清和共享心智模型等新交互能力。
